web.title: Basemaps for MapLibre
web.description: # Basemaps for MapLibre [​](https://docs.protomaps.com/basemaps/maplibre#basemaps-for-maplibre) ## Creating styles programatically [​](https://docs.protomaps.com/basemaps/maplibre#creating-styles-programatically) ### Using the npm package [​](https://docs.protomaps.com/basemaps/maplibre#using-the-npm-package) ``` npm install @protomaps/basemaps ``` ``` import { layers, namedFlavor } from '@protomaps/basemaps'; ``` ``` style: { version: 8, glyphs:'https://protomaps.github.io/basemaps-assets/fonts/{fontstack}/{range}.pbf', sprite: "https://protomaps.github.io/basemaps-assets/sprites/v4/light", sources: { "protomaps": { type: "vector", url: "pmtiles://https://example.com/example.pmtiles", // ^-- Remember to prefix the URL with pmtiles:// attribution: 'Protomaps © OpenStreetMap' } }, layers: layers("protomaps",namedFlavor("light"),{lang:"en"}) } ``` the `layers` from `@protomaps/basemaps` is a function that takes 3 arguments: ### Using a CDN [​](https://docs.protomaps.com/basemaps/maplibre#using-a-cdn) ``` layers: basemaps.layers("protomaps",basemaps.namedFlavor("light"),{lang:"en"}) ```

web.title: Basemap Layers
web.description:
# Basemap Layers [​](https://docs.protomaps.com/basemaps/layers#basemap-layers)
The Protomaps basemap is built on [OpenStreetMap](https://openstreetmap.org/) and [Natural Earth](https://naturalearthdata.com/) data. It does not include all data and tags from OSM; instead it is designed to strike a balance between tile size and completeness, for use as a general-purpose context map.

## earth [​](https://docs.protomaps.com/basemaps/layers#earth)
Polygons from the Natural Earth 50m `land` theme for z0-z4, 10m for z5, preprocessed land polygons from [OSMCoastline](https://osmdata.openstreetmap.de/) for z6+.

## landcover [​](https://docs.protomaps.com/basemaps/layers#landcover)
Polygons from the Daylight distribution's [landcover](https://daylightmap.org/2023/10/11/landcover.html) theme, for z0-z7.
